clean_source_blocks.text: More than 260 people in the Democratic Republic of Congo are known to have died during the current outbreak.

A first case of Ebola has been reported in France with a doctor returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo testing positive. The doctor had returned from a humanitarian mission, the French healthy ministry said, and has caught the virus during the latest outbreak. The patient is being isolated and ⁠authorities are contact tracing, ⁠the ministry said, adding that the risk for the general ‌European population was low. Congo's Ebola outbreak, which has infected more than ⁠1,000 people and killed 267, has had the largest number of confirmed cases within ⁠the first month of any episode ⁠of the disease, the World Health Organisation said. Tracing those who had been in contact with patients remains a major challenge.

Healthcare workers are at high risk of contracting Ebola France has confirmed its first case of Ebola - a doctor who had returned from a humanitarian mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The doctor was "immediately admitted to a specialised facility" and is in a stable condition, the French health ministry said on Wednesday. DR Congo announced an Ebola outbreak last month, but experts believe the virus had been circulating for weeks previously. More than 260 people are confirmed to have died from the virus in the central African country, while 1,000 people have been infected. The doctor was "immediately admitted to a specialised facility" and is in a stable condition, the French health ministry said on Wednesday.

[Lähde: The Mirror]
A first case of Ebola has been reported in France with a doctor returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo testing positive.

The doctor had returned from a humanitarian mission, the French healthy ministry said, and has caught the virus during the latest outbreak.

The patient is being isolated and ⁠authorities are contact tracing, ⁠the ministry said, adding that the risk for the general ‌European population was low.

Congo's Ebola outbreak, which has infected more than ⁠1,000 people and killed 267, has had the largest number of confirmed cases within ⁠the first month of any episode ⁠of the disease, the World Health Organisation said.

Tracing those who had been in contact with patients remains a major challenge.

A total of 100 people have recovered in the outbreak concentrated in the Ituri province since it was declared on May 15, Congo’s Ministry of Health said. At least 365 patients are in hospitals or in isolation.

The Ebola outbreak caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, which has no vaccines or treatment, was the worst ever in its first month and officials admit there could be far more cases they still don’t know about with the peak of the outbreak is still ahead.

Contact tracing remains a key issue for local authorities, who have only achieved a 55% coverage rate, the ministry said.

“If you want to control an outbreak, especially Ebola outbreak, you must know the index case. We don’t have confidence on when this outbreak started,” said the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya.

Officials also are yet to identify the patient zero and trace more than 35,000 people who have come in contact with infected individuals as of last week, authorities said.

That’s partly because eastern Congo is also battling ongoing violence from rebels. In Ituri, attacks by the Islamic State group-backed Allied Democratic Force have cut off access to many villages and forced people to flee their homes, including those sheltering in overcrowded camps and others constantly on the move.

More than a month into the outbreak, officials believe the disease continues to outpace response efforts and no one knows its true scale.

At the Kigonze displacement camp in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, camp officials said last Friday that 10 people had died over the past week in unusual circumstances, raising the fear of a possible outbreak in the camp of over 20,000 displaced people.

payload.title: Ranska vahvisti ensimmäisen ebolatapauksensa
payload.summary: Ranska on vahvistanut ensimmäisen ebolatapauksensa. Tartunnan saanut lääkäri oli palannut humanitaariselta tehtävältä Kongon demokraattisesta tasavallasta, jossa nykyinen epidemia on tappanut yli 260 ihmistä.
payload.content:
Ranska on vahvistanut maan ensimmäisen ebolatapauksen lääkärillä, joka oli palannut humanitaariselta tehtävältä Kongon demokraattisesta tasavallasta. Ranskan terveysministeriön mukaan potilas otettiin heti erikoistuneeseen hoitopaikkaan, ja hänen tilansa on vakaa.

## Lääkäri eristettiin hoitoon

Ranskan terveysministeriö kertoi keskiviikkona, että tartunnan saanut lääkäri oli ollut humanitaarisella tehtävällä Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa. Ministeriön mukaan hän sai viruksen nykyisen ebolaepidemian aikana.

Potilas on eristetty, ja viranomaiset ovat aloittaneet kontaktien jäljittämisen. Jäljityksessä selvitetään, ketkä ovat voineet olla tekemisissä potilaan kanssa. Ministeriön mukaan riski Euroopan väestölle yleisesti on pieni.

Terveydenhuollon työntekijöillä on ebolan yhteydessä suuri tartuntariski. Siksi Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa tehtävä hoito- ja avustustyö on erityisen vaativaa, kun epidemia on samalla levinnyt laajalle.

## Kongon epidemia on tappanut yli 260 ihmistä

Kongon demokraattinen tasavalta ilmoitti ebolaepidemiasta viime kuussa. Asiantuntijoiden mukaan virus oli todennäköisesti kiertänyt alueella jo useita viikkoja ennen epidemian virallista toteamista.

Nykyisessä epidemiassa yli 260 ihmisen on vahvistettu kuolleen. Lähdetietojen mukaan tartuntoja on ollut yli 1 000, ja yhdessä tarkemmassa luvussa kuolleita mainitaan 267.

Maailman terveysjärjestön mukaan epidemian vahvistettujen tapausten määrä ensimmäisen kuukauden aikana on ollut suurempi kuin missään aiemmassa ebolaepidemiassa vastaavassa vaiheessa. Tämä kertoo taudin nopeasta etenemisestä Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa.

## Kontaktien jäljittäminen jatkuu

Yksi epidemian suurista haasteista on niiden ihmisten jäljittäminen, jotka ovat olleet tekemisissä sairastuneiden kanssa. Sama työ on aloitettu myös Ranskassa vahvistetun tapauksen yhteydessä.

Ranskan viranomaiset ovat kertoneet potilaan olevan vakaassa tilassa erikoistuneessa hoidossa. Tapauksesta on ilmoitettu uutistilanteena, josta odotetaan lisää tietoja viranomaisilta.
